boundary: This closes the ordinary critical and ignore-defense passive probability gates and their RNG order for successful hits. It does not identify every passive display name, status modifier, forced-miss action subtype, linked-attack rule, healing rule, or non-damage effect.
conclusion: After a successful base hit, passive type 0x0C independently upgrades flag 1 to critical flag 2, then passive type 0x19 independently ORs mask 4. The controlled 100-percent samples resolve exactly through the critical defended and normal ignore-defense candidates.
method: Validate the exact passive-query and RNG instruction order in the original hit generator, then compare one natural three-hit route with two single-byte savestate patches that make the critical or ignore-defense passive value exactly 100 percent.
